title: AI-Run Modern LaTeX Manuscript Workflow and Replication Packet
description:
Compact workflow and replication record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It documents the AI-run scan-to-TeX-to-translation-to-audit-to-publication workflow, including local source acquisition, OCR/math-OCR witness generation, source-image slicing, high-DPI object crops, TeX compilation, web review handoffs, GitHub mirroring, and Zenodo publication.

Latest update, 2026-06-25. Adds source-witness/public-surface and archive-scope guardrail addenda from current SGA, Noether, Gordan, Steinitz, Deligne, Cayley, and local sweep maintenance lessons, plus a failed-web salvage rule from Noether repair work. This update also adds the SGA5 and Weber find-verify-fix method snapshots. The SGA5 snapshot packages page-local discovery, independent source verification, deterministic old-string/new-string patching, compile gates, and the lesson that agent/swarm passes are finders rather than certifiers. The Weber snapshot adapts the same method to German transcription/source-completeness first: detect omissions, compression, and missing formulae before English translation; no native >=650 dpi Weber scan is currently on disk, with Band I/III around 500 dpi and Band II around 560 dpi, so hard symbols require tight crops and explicit uncertainty flags. The GitHub mirror carries the Weber workflow-method snapshot through Band I p401. Later author-staging packages add B139d p402-p407, B139e p408-p413, B140 p414-p467, B141 p468-p473, B142 hold evidence for p474-p479, and B143 p480-p485 / section 150 re-transcription as author-record staging; these later ranges are not yet folded into the compact workflow ZIP. B143 adds a practical guardrail: after a held or no-compile range, the next range still needs fresh source renders/crops/output checks; an unusually fast all-clean report is a missing-scan/tooling warning, not evidence of correctness. Refresh the workflow packet before claiming p413+ coverage inside the workflow artifact.

The addenda formalize the difference between OCR/source-witness aids, failed-run locator packets, working drafts, source-witnessed tranches, source-closed loci, critical editions, and unrelated local mathematical files that should not be published as part of this project.

Scope guardrail. Local sweep may inspect broad folders, but publication is limited to the manuscript transcription/translation/source-audit project unless Floris explicitly requests a named non-project upload. A file being mathematical, interesting, recently downloaded, or technically publishable is not enough.

Workflow status. The record is a reusable workflow packet, not a claim that any particular mathematical edition is critically complete. OCR, VLM, detector, crop, candidate-TeX, derivative PDF, failed web-run transcript, and source-inventory outputs are witness and locator layers unless a source-specific audit promotes them. Source scans and source-object witnesses remain authority for transcription claims.

Corrections and contributions. Workflow corrections, tool notes, reproducibility improvements, and issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

notes: Adds workflow_addendum_20260624_source_witness_public_surface.md, workflow_addendum_20260624_archive_scope_guardrail.md, the compact archive-scope guardrail ZIP, the 2026-06-25 failed-web salvage rule now documented in docs/workflow.md, AI_Run_Workflow_SGA5_FindVerifyFix_Workpass_Method_20260625.zip (321911 bytes, SHA256 577A4DBD949BEBBEF07965C5A9FE89F01FD6B59010DE9034451FE1B840A8D808), AI_Run_Workflow_Weber_FindVerifyFix_Audit_Method_20260625.zip (77679 bytes, SHA256 C7267DCBD2B3A4CEEC6A671BF26D130DA15C183A0181034D39AB073C0E04A04C), AI_Run_Workflow_SGA6_PageUnit_AuditHarness_KimiLocator_20260624.zip (13596 bytes, SHA256 B03F3F80C3C8A502470A0F89E3261F0D51BF994B722289F3724E43118459579D), and AI_Run_Workflow_Weber_LiveAudit_Method_p100_p527_20260625.zip (95572 bytes, SHA256 6389C15F9FC730F3519BDBEF655F7BFC4DB6F7A12566163D69D647D0D0B20F92). Core rules: do not let filenames carry quality claims; OCR is a coverage/source locator, not authority; high-resolution source packets should include page maps, object inventories, crops with context, output renders, stable object IDs, and ledger verdicts; failed or crashed web-review runs may be preserved as salvage/locator evidence only when they carry explicit do-not-promote/no-fix-trap ledgers and source-quality notes; SGA5/SGA6/Weber-style agents and OCR/witness workflows are finders/check layers, not certification by themselves; no-patch survival bridges and source-search packets are anti-regression/source-routing aids that should record span hashes, source-search failures, raw-source archive checksums, and current branch pointers, but they are not reader editions, proof, certification, critical editions, or source-fidelity verification; after held/no-compile ranges, the next range still requires fresh source renders and output checks, and an anomalously fast all-clean report should be treated as a missing-scan/tooling failure until proven otherwise; audit bundles should be routed as provenance/support unless they close a public-facing uncertainty; found-on-disk does not mean publish; unrelated third-party TeX, new research drafts, Reddit downloads, Lean/library-candidate side material, and personal/novel math files stay out unless Floris explicitly names the exact item for upload; critical-edition language is reserved for explicit human certification. The 2026-06-25 Classical Lean watch lane is tracked as Lean formalization/library-candidate material only, not proof of archival source fidelity, not certification, and not source-audit evidence; evening direct recheck has AffineGroup/Steinitz/Weber green, ClassicalBatch2 failed/sorry-tainted, SplitZero green but side-lane, and the updated watch ZIP is 56634 bytes with SHA256 AF877C2FD65E8D2D892AB19BBB662588F51EDA38E0D1B06BD31187AD93B726B9; ordinary Lean build/sense-check review is required before any DOI claim; this lane is useful library-candidate material, not manuscript source-alignment or archive audit. Fabrication is a distinct failure mode: the Weber p486-p497 audit found fluent plausible GPT prose not present in Weber, so section-level source page mapping must precede surgical patch promotion; if a fabricated frame is found, hold and re-transcribe the coherent section from source. 2026-07-02 queued workflow/interlanguage evidence from the laptop branch adds cross-lane promotion-readiness, review-intake, visual-inspection coverage, and Simplified Chinese contact-sheet triage ledgers. Method lesson: TeX compilation and first-page contact-sheet checks are not promotion-grade visual inspection; front/middle/back and dense-page checks remain required, and external review returns must be ingested through explicit accepted-review ledgers rather than inferred from local editorial work.
